themes.name: Strengthening Community
themes.definition: People describe the relationships, shared practices, and collective spirit that make a place feel connected and able to work together.

sub_themes.name: Community Solidarity
sub_themes.definition: People emphasize standing together, supporting one another, or acting as a unified community in ordinary times.

sub_themes.name: Neighbor Connection
sub_themes.definition: People describe knowing, visiting, communicating with, or relying on nearby neighbors as a source of local connection.

sub_themes.name: Shared Gathering
sub_themes.definition: People connect through events, celebrations, public spaces, meals, or activities that bring residents together.

sub_themes.name: Collective Problem Solving
sub_themes.definition: People work jointly to address local needs, improve their community, or pursue practical solutions.

sub_themes.name: Everyday Kindness
sub_themes.definition: People value small gestures of care, courtesy, generosity, and helpfulness as foundations for community life.

sub_themes.name: Community Trust
sub_themes.definition: People describe confidence, reciprocity, and dependable relationships among residents or local groups.

themes.name: Serving Others
themes.definition: People discuss giving time, money, skills, or practical support to meet others' needs and strengthen their communities.

sub_themes.name: Volunteer Service
sub_themes.definition: People participate in, value, or depend on formal or informal volunteering for community benefit.

sub_themes.name: Mutual Aid
sub_themes.definition: People share resources or provide direct reciprocal help, often outside formal institutions.

sub_themes.name: Practical Assistance
sub_themes.definition: People provide or receive tangible help such as food, supplies, transport, caregiving, or other immediate necessities.

sub_themes.name: Charitable Giving
sub_themes.definition: People donate money, goods, or fundraising support to assist people and community organizations.

sub_themes.name: Service Commitment
sub_themes.definition: People frame helping others as a sustained personal, civic, faith-based, or professional responsibility.

sub_themes.name: Helping Strangers
sub_themes.definition: People extend care beyond close relationships, including spontaneous aid to unfamiliar or vulnerable people.

themes.name: Civic Participation
themes.definition: People describe taking responsibility for public life through voting, local involvement, advocacy, service, and collective action.

sub_themes.name: Civic Engagement
sub_themes.definition: People participate in community or public affairs, or discuss motivations and pathways for doing so.

sub_themes.name: Voting Participation
sub_themes.definition: People discuss turnout, voting habits, access, civic duty, or obstacles to electoral participation.

sub_themes.name: Civic Responsibility
sub_themes.definition: People frame citizenship as an obligation to contribute, stay informed, or act for the public good.

sub_themes.name: Local Advocacy
sub_themes.definition: People seek to influence local decisions, leaders, policies, institutions, or public investments.

sub_themes.name: Collective Mobilization
sub_themes.definition: People organize, recruit others, or build momentum for community action and change.

sub_themes.name: Civic Disengagement
sub_themes.definition: People describe withdrawal from civic life, low participation, discouragement, or doubts that involvement matters.

themes.name: Bridging Differences
themes.definition: People seek to understand, respect, and build relationships with those whose identities, experiences, or beliefs differ from their own.

sub_themes.name: Perspective Taking
sub_themes.definition: People try to understand how another person's experiences, circumstances, or viewpoint shape what they believe.

sub_themes.name: Open Mindedness
sub_themes.definition: People show willingness to reconsider assumptions, encounter unfamiliar views, or change their minds through learning.

sub_themes.name: Cross Group Contact
sub_themes.definition: People build direct relationships or interactions across political, cultural, racial, religious, or social boundaries.

sub_themes.name: Shared Humanity
sub_themes.definition: People stress common needs, dignity, experiences, or identity that transcend group differences.

sub_themes.name: Curious Learning
sub_themes.definition: People approach unfamiliar people or perspectives with questions, interest, and a desire to learn rather than judge.

sub_themes.name: Difference Acceptance
sub_themes.definition: People affirm the legitimacy of diverse identities, beliefs, backgrounds, and ways of life.

themes.name: Respectful Dialogue
themes.definition: People describe communication practices that make difficult conversations more constructive, safe, and mutually understandable.

sub_themes.name: Active Listening
sub_themes.definition: People listen carefully, generously, or reflectively to understand others before responding.

sub_themes.name: Respectful Disagreement
sub_themes.definition: People maintain civility, respect, and relationship while holding different views or values.

sub_themes.name: Cross Partisan Dialogue
sub_themes.definition: People engage in conversation, friendship, or cooperation across political party or ideological lines.

sub_themes.name: Common Ground
sub_themes.definition: People look for shared values, concerns, goals, or agreements that can support cooperation.

sub_themes.name: Difficult Conversations
sub_themes.definition: People describe the challenge, courage, or need to discuss emotionally charged, divisive, or avoided issues.

sub_themes.name: Dialogue Avoidance
sub_themes.definition: People avoid political or contentious discussion because of discomfort, fear, conflict, or relationship concerns.

themes.name: Political Division
themes.definition: People experience public life as divided by partisan identity, hostility, distrust, and conflict that can spill into relationships and communities.

sub_themes.name: Political Polarization
sub_themes.definition: People describe entrenched partisan or ideological camps that make shared understanding and cooperation difficult.

sub_themes.name: Political Hostility
sub_themes.definition: People encounter anger, contempt, dehumanization, demonization, or aggression in political disagreement.

sub_themes.name: Social Fragmentation
sub_themes.definition: People describe communities, families, or social networks breaking apart around differences and conflict.

sub_themes.name: Family Political Strain
sub_themes.definition: People experience political differences as tension, avoidance, estrangement, or rupture within families.

sub_themes.name: Polarization Reduction
sub_themes.definition: People seek to soften divisions, reject adversarial framing, or restore cooperation across political conflict.

sub_themes.name: Rural Urban Divide
sub_themes.definition: People perceive differences, misunderstandings, or unequal conditions between rural and urban communities.

themes.name: Information Distrust
themes.definition: People describe how media systems, misinformation, and fragmented information environments shape trust, understanding, and civic division.

sub_themes.name: Misinformation Concerns
sub_themes.definition: People worry about false, misleading, unverified, or manipulated information spreading through public life.

sub_themes.name: Media Distrust
sub_themes.definition: People question the fairness, accuracy, motives, ownership, or reliability of news and media sources.

sub_themes.name: Digital Hostility
sub_themes.definition: People experience online spaces as hostile, cruel, anonymous, dehumanizing, or prone to conflict.

sub_themes.name: Echo Chambering
sub_themes.definition: People describe algorithms, social networks, or selective media exposure reinforcing narrow viewpoints and division.

sub_themes.name: Information Verification
sub_themes.definition: People seek facts, context, credible sources, or independent research before forming or sharing opinions.

sub_themes.name: Digital Disconnection
sub_themes.definition: People feel technology, phones, or online interaction displace face-to-face relationships and meaningful social contact.

themes.name: Belonging Inclusion
themes.definition: People describe whether community life feels welcoming, accessible, representative, and open to people with differing backgrounds and identities.

sub_themes.name: Community Belonging
sub_themes.definition: People feel attached to, accepted in, or emotionally at home within a local community.

sub_themes.name: Welcoming Newcomers
sub_themes.definition: People describe efforts or barriers affecting whether newcomers, outsiders, immigrants, or strangers are welcomed into community life.

sub_themes.name: Inclusive Participation
sub_themes.definition: People seek equal voice, broad representation, accessibility, and meaningful involvement in shared spaces or decisions.

sub_themes.name: Cultural Inclusion
sub_themes.definition: People value diversity, cultural exchange, and respect across racial, ethnic, religious, language, or cultural differences.

sub_themes.name: Marginalized Belonging
sub_themes.definition: People discuss exclusion or inclusion affecting racial minorities, LGBTQ people, immigrants, people with disabilities, or other marginalized groups.

sub_themes.name: Social Isolation
sub_themes.definition: People experience loneliness, disconnection, exclusion, or a lack of meaningful social ties.

themes.name: Crisis Solidarity
themes.definition: People describe how disasters, violence, pandemics, and collective trauma test communities while sometimes generating mutual support, resilience, and remembrance.

sub_themes.name: Disaster Solidarity
sub_themes.definition: People unite, volunteer, donate, or provide mutual aid in response to natural disasters and emergencies.

sub_themes.name: Community Resilience
sub_themes.definition: People describe recovering, adapting, persevering, or rebuilding together after hardship or disruption.

sub_themes.name: Traumatic Memory
sub_themes.definition: People carry, share, preserve, or confront memories of collective violence, loss, and traumatic events.

sub_themes.name: Collective Mourning
sub_themes.definition: People grieve together, honor victims, support bereaved people, or use memorial practices to process loss.

sub_themes.name: Pandemic Disconnection
sub_themes.definition: People describe isolation, disruption, conflict, or social division associated with the COVID-19 pandemic.

sub_themes.name: Tragedy Unity
sub_themes.definition: People describe tragedy as a catalyst for temporary or enduring connection, compassion, and shared purpose.

themes.name: Place Pride
themes.definition: People express attachment to their town, region, state, or nation through appreciation of local character, shared identity, history, and traditions.

sub_themes.name: Community Pride
sub_themes.definition: People express affection, admiration, satisfaction, or positive identification with their community.

sub_themes.name: Civic Pride
sub_themes.definition: People take pride in public institutions, civic life, democracy, collective achievements, or community service.

sub_themes.name: Small Town Identity
sub_themes.definition: People value the familiarity, relationships, character, or particular challenges of small-town and rural life.

sub_themes.name: Local Heritage
sub_themes.definition: People preserve, learn from, celebrate, or identify with local history, landmarks, and inherited traditions.

sub_themes.name: Shared Traditions
sub_themes.definition: People sustain family, cultural, civic, or community rituals that create continuity and connection across time.

sub_themes.name: National Solidarity
sub_themes.definition: People express a shared national identity, patriotism, unity, or concern for national cohesion.

themes.name: Learning Growth
themes.definition: People describe education, reflection, lived experience, and intergenerational exchange as ways to build understanding and improve civic and community life.

sub_themes.name: Lifelong Learning
sub_themes.definition: People seek ongoing learning, self-reflection, and growth from experiences, mistakes, and other people.

sub_themes.name: Civic Education
sub_themes.definition: People emphasize learning about government, voting, public institutions, rights, and responsibilities as preparation for participation.

sub_themes.name: Learning Across Differences
sub_themes.definition: People gain understanding through exposure to diverse people, stories, viewpoints, and lived experiences.

sub_themes.name: Historical Learning
sub_themes.definition: People seek to understand history, injustice, collective memory, and past events to inform present choices.

sub_themes.name: Intergenerational Exchange
sub_themes.definition: People share knowledge, guidance, mentorship, or understanding across age groups and generations.

sub_themes.name: Youth Empowerment
sub_themes.definition: People support young people's voice, leadership, civic development, and capacity to shape their communities.

themes.name: Community Challenges
themes.definition: People discuss material, institutional, and structural conditions that constrain community wellbeing, participation, and opportunity.

sub_themes.name: Economic Hardship
sub_themes.definition: People experience financial strain, rising costs, poverty, job loss, or insecurity that limits daily life and community involvement.

sub_themes.name: Housing Insecurity
sub_themes.definition: People face shortages, unaffordability, displacement, instability, or barriers to safe housing.

sub_themes.name: Food Insecurity
sub_themes.definition: People describe inadequate food access and community responses such as food assistance, pantries, and donations.

sub_themes.name: Resource Inequality
sub_themes.definition: People describe unequal access to public resources, services, infrastructure, education, or opportunity.

sub_themes.name: Institutional Distrust
sub_themes.definition: People lack confidence in government, public institutions, leaders, or systems because of perceived exclusion, inaction, or failure.

sub_themes.name: Participation Barriers
sub_themes.definition: People face time, cost, access, scheduling, transportation, or confidence barriers to joining civic and community activities.

themes.definition: People describe the relationships, shared practices, and collective spirit that make a place feel connected and able to work together.

sub_themes.name: Community Solidarity
sub_themes.definition: People emphasize standing together, supporting one another, or acting as a unified community in ordinary times.

sub_themes.name: Neighbor Connection
sub_themes.definition: People describe knowing, visiting, communicating with, or relying on nearby neighbors as a source of local connection.

sub_themes.name: Shared Gathering
sub_themes.definition: People connect through events, celebrations, public spaces, meals, or activities that bring residents together.

sub_themes.name: Collective Problem Solving
sub_themes.definition: People work jointly to address local needs, improve their community, or pursue practical solutions.

sub_themes.name: Everyday Kindness
sub_themes.definition: People value small gestures of care, courtesy, generosity, and helpfulness as foundations for community life.

sub_themes.name: Community Trust
sub_themes.definition: People describe confidence, reciprocity, and dependable relationships among residents or local groups.

themes.name: Serving Others
themes.definition: People discuss giving time, money, skills, or practical support to meet others' needs and strengthen their communities.

sub_themes.name: Volunteer Service
sub_themes.definition: People participate in, value, or depend on formal or informal volunteering for community benefit.

sub_themes.name: Mutual Aid
sub_themes.definition: People share resources or provide direct reciprocal help, often outside formal institutions.

sub_themes.name: Practical Assistance
sub_themes.definition: People provide or receive tangible help such as food, supplies, transport, caregiving, or other immediate necessities.

sub_themes.name: Charitable Giving
sub_themes.definition: People donate money, goods, or fundraising support to assist people and community organizations.

sub_themes.name: Service Commitment
sub_themes.definition: People frame helping others as a sustained personal, civic, faith-based, or professional responsibility.

sub_themes.name: Helping Strangers
sub_themes.definition: People extend care beyond close relationships, including spontaneous aid to unfamiliar or vulnerable people.

themes.name: Civic Participation
themes.definition: People describe taking responsibility for public life through voting, local involvement, advocacy, service, and collective action.

sub_themes.name: Civic Engagement
sub_themes.definition: People participate in community or public affairs, or discuss motivations and pathways for doing so.

sub_themes.name: Voting Participation
sub_themes.definition: People discuss turnout, voting habits, access, civic duty, or obstacles to electoral participation.

sub_themes.name: Civic Responsibility
sub_themes.definition: People frame citizenship as an obligation to contribute, stay informed, or act for the public good.

sub_themes.name: Local Advocacy
sub_themes.definition: People seek to influence local decisions, leaders, policies, institutions, or public investments.

sub_themes.name: Collective Mobilization
sub_themes.definition: People organize, recruit others, or build momentum for community action and change.

sub_themes.name: Civic Disengagement
sub_themes.definition: People describe withdrawal from civic life, low participation, discouragement, or doubts that involvement matters.

themes.name: Bridging Differences
themes.definition: People seek to understand, respect, and build relationships with those whose identities, experiences, or beliefs differ from their own.

sub_themes.name: Perspective Taking
sub_themes.definition: People try to understand how another person's experiences, circumstances, or viewpoint shape what they believe.

sub_themes.name: Open Mindedness
sub_themes.definition: People show willingness to reconsider assumptions, encounter unfamiliar views, or change their minds through learning.

sub_themes.name: Cross Group Contact
sub_themes.definition: People build direct relationships or interactions across political, cultural, racial, religious, or social boundaries.

sub_themes.name: Shared Humanity
sub_themes.definition: People stress common needs, dignity, experiences, or identity that transcend group differences.

sub_themes.name: Curious Learning
sub_themes.definition: People approach unfamiliar people or perspectives with questions, interest, and a desire to learn rather than judge.

sub_themes.name: Difference Acceptance
sub_themes.definition: People affirm the legitimacy of diverse identities, beliefs, backgrounds, and ways of life.

themes.name: Respectful Dialogue
themes.definition: People describe communication practices that make difficult conversations more constructive, safe, and mutually understandable.

sub_themes.name: Active Listening
sub_themes.definition: People listen carefully, generously, or reflectively to understand others before responding.

sub_themes.name: Respectful Disagreement
sub_themes.definition: People maintain civility, respect, and relationship while holding different views or values.

sub_themes.name: Cross Partisan Dialogue
sub_themes.definition: People engage in conversation, friendship, or cooperation across political party or ideological lines.

sub_themes.name: Common Ground
sub_themes.definition: People look for shared values, concerns, goals, or agreements that can support cooperation.

sub_themes.name: Difficult Conversations
sub_themes.definition: People describe the challenge, courage, or need to discuss emotionally charged, divisive, or avoided issues.

sub_themes.name: Dialogue Avoidance
sub_themes.definition: People avoid political or contentious discussion because of discomfort, fear, conflict, or relationship concerns.

themes.name: Political Division
themes.definition: People experience public life as divided by partisan identity, hostility, distrust, and conflict that can spill into relationships and communities.

sub_themes.name: Political Polarization
sub_themes.definition: People describe entrenched partisan or ideological camps that make shared understanding and cooperation difficult.

sub_themes.name: Political Hostility
sub_themes.definition: People encounter anger, contempt, dehumanization, demonization, or aggression in political disagreement.

sub_themes.name: Social Fragmentation
sub_themes.definition: People describe communities, families, or social networks breaking apart around differences and conflict.

sub_themes.name: Family Political Strain
sub_themes.definition: People experience political differences as tension, avoidance, estrangement, or rupture within families.

sub_themes.name: Polarization Reduction
sub_themes.definition: People seek to soften divisions, reject adversarial framing, or restore cooperation across political conflict.

sub_themes.name: Rural Urban Divide
sub_themes.definition: People perceive differences, misunderstandings, or unequal conditions between rural and urban communities.

themes.name: Information Distrust
themes.definition: People describe how media systems, misinformation, and fragmented information environments shape trust, understanding, and civic division.

sub_themes.name: Misinformation Concerns
sub_themes.definition: People worry about false, misleading, unverified, or manipulated information spreading through public life.

sub_themes.name: Media Distrust
sub_themes.definition: People question the fairness, accuracy, motives, ownership, or reliability of news and media sources.

sub_themes.name: Digital Hostility
sub_themes.definition: People experience online spaces as hostile, cruel, anonymous, dehumanizing, or prone to conflict.

sub_themes.name: Echo Chambering
sub_themes.definition: People describe algorithms, social networks, or selective media exposure reinforcing narrow viewpoints and division.

sub_themes.name: Information Verification
sub_themes.definition: People seek facts, context, credible sources, or independent research before forming or sharing opinions.

sub_themes.name: Digital Disconnection
sub_themes.definition: People feel technology, phones, or online interaction displace face-to-face relationships and meaningful social contact.

themes.name: Belonging Inclusion
themes.definition: People describe whether community life feels welcoming, accessible, representative, and open to people with differing backgrounds and identities.

sub_themes.name: Community Belonging
sub_themes.definition: People feel attached to, accepted in, or emotionally at home within a local community.

sub_themes.name: Welcoming Newcomers
sub_themes.definition: People describe efforts or barriers affecting whether newcomers, outsiders, immigrants, or strangers are welcomed into community life.

sub_themes.name: Inclusive Participation
sub_themes.definition: People seek equal voice, broad representation, accessibility, and meaningful involvement in shared spaces or decisions.

sub_themes.name: Cultural Inclusion
sub_themes.definition: People value diversity, cultural exchange, and respect across racial, ethnic, religious, language, or cultural differences.

sub_themes.name: Marginalized Belonging
sub_themes.definition: People discuss exclusion or inclusion affecting racial minorities, LGBTQ people, immigrants, people with disabilities, or other marginalized groups.

sub_themes.name: Social Isolation
sub_themes.definition: People experience loneliness, disconnection, exclusion, or a lack of meaningful social ties.

themes.name: Crisis Solidarity
themes.definition: People describe how disasters, violence, pandemics, and collective trauma test communities while sometimes generating mutual support, resilience, and remembrance.

sub_themes.name: Disaster Solidarity
sub_themes.definition: People unite, volunteer, donate, or provide mutual aid in response to natural disasters and emergencies.

sub_themes.name: Community Resilience
sub_themes.definition: People describe recovering, adapting, persevering, or rebuilding together after hardship or disruption.

sub_themes.name: Traumatic Memory
sub_themes.definition: People carry, share, preserve, or confront memories of collective violence, loss, and traumatic events.

sub_themes.name: Collective Mourning
sub_themes.definition: People grieve together, honor victims, support bereaved people, or use memorial practices to process loss.

sub_themes.name: Pandemic Disconnection
sub_themes.definition: People describe isolation, disruption, conflict, or social division associated with the COVID-19 pandemic.

sub_themes.name: Tragedy Unity
sub_themes.definition: People describe tragedy as a catalyst for temporary or enduring connection, compassion, and shared purpose.

themes.name: Place Pride
themes.definition: People express attachment to their town, region, state, or nation through appreciation of local character, shared identity, history, and traditions.

sub_themes.name: Community Pride
sub_themes.definition: People express affection, admiration, satisfaction, or positive identification with their community.

sub_themes.name: Civic Pride
sub_themes.definition: People take pride in public institutions, civic life, democracy, collective achievements, or community service.

sub_themes.name: Small Town Identity
sub_themes.definition: People value the familiarity, relationships, character, or particular challenges of small-town and rural life.

sub_themes.name: Local Heritage
sub_themes.definition: People preserve, learn from, celebrate, or identify with local history, landmarks, and inherited traditions.

sub_themes.name: Shared Traditions
sub_themes.definition: People sustain family, cultural, civic, or community rituals that create continuity and connection across time.

sub_themes.name: National Solidarity
sub_themes.definition: People express a shared national identity, patriotism, unity, or concern for national cohesion.

themes.name: Learning Growth
themes.definition: People describe education, reflection, lived experience, and intergenerational exchange as ways to build understanding and improve civic and community life.

sub_themes.name: Lifelong Learning
sub_themes.definition: People seek ongoing learning, self-reflection, and growth from experiences, mistakes, and other people.

sub_themes.name: Civic Education
sub_themes.definition: People emphasize learning about government, voting, public institutions, rights, and responsibilities as preparation for participation.

sub_themes.name: Learning Across Differences
sub_themes.definition: People gain understanding through exposure to diverse people, stories, viewpoints, and lived experiences.

sub_themes.name: Historical Learning
sub_themes.definition: People seek to understand history, injustice, collective memory, and past events to inform present choices.

sub_themes.name: Intergenerational Exchange
sub_themes.definition: People share knowledge, guidance, mentorship, or understanding across age groups and generations.

sub_themes.name: Youth Empowerment
sub_themes.definition: People support young people's voice, leadership, civic development, and capacity to shape their communities.

themes.name: Community Challenges
themes.definition: People discuss material, institutional, and structural conditions that constrain community wellbeing, participation, and opportunity.

sub_themes.name: Economic Hardship
sub_themes.definition: People experience financial strain, rising costs, poverty, job loss, or insecurity that limits daily life and community involvement.

sub_themes.name: Housing Insecurity
sub_themes.definition: People face shortages, unaffordability, displacement, instability, or barriers to safe housing.

sub_themes.name: Food Insecurity
sub_themes.definition: People describe inadequate food access and community responses such as food assistance, pantries, and donations.

sub_themes.name: Resource Inequality
sub_themes.definition: People describe unequal access to public resources, services, infrastructure, education, or opportunity.

sub_themes.name: Institutional Distrust
sub_themes.definition: People lack confidence in government, public institutions, leaders, or systems because of perceived exclusion, inaction, or failure.

sub_themes.name: Participation Barriers
sub_themes.definition: People face time, cost, access, scheduling, transportation, or confidence barriers to joining civic and community activities.
